natural_body: Deep discounts spike signups +31% but risk renewal. Use tactically with guardrails.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and two prior records indicate that shorter onboarding and reduced signup friction durably improved early activation and time-to-value. This directly addresses the observed funnel deterioration with lower long-term value risk than reactive discounting. Pricing pressure remains material, but aggressive discounts have a documented renewal risk and should be considered only with explicit guardrails after verification.
